text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper focuses on potential redistribution of tree species habitat under climate change scenarios in the eastern US, using regression tree analysis to model species distributions. It lacks spatially explicit LULC outputs or mapping of land cover change per se. The study does not meet the core inclusion criteria related to LULC prediction at national scale, nor does it implement LULC change scenarios. Therefore, it is excluded as a species/ecological focus unrelated to LULC.)
